taxonomy_review.notes: Current taxonomy loaded. Existing mapping roles and unresolved candidates retained after recognition/exclusion review. Misleading access representations remain distinct from service impact, upgrade purchase and AI-mediated economic solicitation.

taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: A narrower Codex RBAC state was used to represent availability of the broader new ChatGPT app even though ChatGPT Classic remained accessible, collapsing materially distinct access conditions at the new-app boundary.

Classic remained a practical alternative to the Codex-coupled new app, but the reported Codex RBAC-disabled state is a component permission restriction rather than an evidenced temporarily unavailable or inconclusive verification pathway. The occurrence materially distinguishes fallback availability from fulfillment of the verification-noncompletion success conditions; it establishes neither FC-048 failure nor success.

old_assessment.coverage_note: All eleven dimensions were re-checked against the completed provider timeline. The first-party record confirms a prolonged but bounded impairment of the new ChatGPT app for the affected Enterprise permission state, with ChatGPT Classic explicitly available as a fallback. The recurrence does not establish broader organisational harm or total ChatGPT unavailability, so the existing S2 service/operational band remains supported.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The access failure/erroneous enforcement is unwanted behaviour engaging the repair benchmark. After a fix and recurrence, OpenAI reports that all impacted services fully recovered; ChatGPT Classic was also supplied as a temporary alternative. That is affirmative, source-bounded evidence of repair restoring service in this recovery stage; it does not establish cause, individual completeness beyond the report, or prevention of recurrence.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The preserved restoration after the access/suspension failure directly raises the OECD appropriate-mechanisms-for-repair proposition independently of an FC candidate.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: Service access loss disengaged the affected operational GAI use context, making communication planning relevant. The status report gives the affected Codex-permission cohort, ChatGPT Classic workaround, fix, recurrence and final recovery, but does not preserve the maintained internal communication plan or all context-specific contact provisions. Public communication is affirmative evidence of communication, but not proof of the complete planning requirement.
